settlement.schemeNote: x402 exact on SVM is an SPL TransferChecked. The client builds and partially signs the transaction; the facilitator adds its own signature as fee payer and submits. That is a different trust shape from the EVM path, where the client signs an EIP-3009 authorization and never builds a transaction at all -- on Solana the facilitator pays the network fee, so it needs a funded keypair and a rate limit.
